title: PS2 Dance Dance Revolution Extreme Case & Manual Only, No Game
categoryName: Video Games & Consoles:Manuals, Inserts & Box Art
descriptionText: This listing is for a PlayStation 2 game, Dance Dance Revolution Extreme, including the original case and manual. The game is not included with this purchase. It is a great option for those who already have the game and need a replacement case or for collectors who want to have the original packaging. The brand is PlayStation and the model is Playstation 2. This item falls under the categories of Manuals, Inserts & Box Art and Video Games & Consoles.
